import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

### Critique
The bank epic already put subscriptions in an album under `bank`, with check proposing and never creating. Keep that. Change the rest:

- Live bank is four days old (`start: 2026-11-11`). The last few months live in 2025 `@BANK`, and those amounts have drifted (Spotify $11.72 → $12.78; live GoDaddy $46.38; live Claude $200).
- Title-only restaurant lookup misses `SPOTIFY`, `Anthropic* Claude`, and `Godaddy#••••`. Learned naming only copies a link after an acknowledged teacher exists, and import never rewrites a row it already wrote.
- An album-level bag of strings cannot name which record won. `bank.rules` should stay the override, not the catalog.

### Recommended design
A `subscriptions` album under `bank` (emoji `🔁`). Each record has a required unique `match` list: case-insensitive substrings of the **raw** bank description, same `contains_folded` as rules.

Import link order: rule `link:` → learned acknowledged twin → **exactly one** record hit → none. The written form is `[[subscriptions/spotify|🔁]]`, styled as a small chip on the existing `<a>` (eat’s `🍔` uses the same class). Unique subscription hits also fill unspecified payee/category (`Godaddy#••••` → `GoDaddy`).

`bob bank check` stays green: fixed-price drift and new ~30/365-day candidates are info; a charge against a cancelled record is a warning. Import never creates records. Track 5 Coffee must not look like a subscription.

**Seed from `old_recur` ∪ recent `@BANK` ∪ live rows**, not the Zorg table blindly. Include Verizon; exclude train as transit. Claude is `metered`. One-time patch of the two live hits (GoDaddy, Claude). Then de-zorg `old_recur` into `legacy_recur` and rewrite the 270 inbound links.

Create with `bob albums create`, then YAML for fields and `index_facets` (`albums update` cannot set those). Full roster, needles, ADJs, and implementation order are in the report.
